"Implement the solution in src/main/java/MazeGenerator.java so that the tests in src/test/java/MazeGeneratorTest.java pass. The specification follows.

# Instructions

Your task is to generate the perfect mazes for Mickey and Minerva — those with only one solution and no isolated sections.
Here's what you need to know:

- The maze has a rectangular shape with an opening at the start and end.
- The maze has rooms and passages, which intersect at right angles.
- The program should accept two parameters: rows and columns. The maze should be between 5 and 100 cells in size.
- A maze which is `x` columns wide and `y` rows high should be `2x + 1` characters wide and `2y + 1` characters high.
- If no seed is provided, generate a random maze. If the same seed is provided multiple times, the resulting maze should be the same each time.
- Use [box-drawing][Box-drawing] characters to draw walls, and an arrow symbol (⇨) for the entrance on the left and exit on the right.

It's time to create some perfect mazes for these adventurous mice!

## Examples

1. A small square maze 5x5 cells (or 11x11 characters)

    ```text
    ┌───────┬─┐
    │       │ │
    │ ┌─┬── │ │
    │ │ │   │ ⇨
    │ │ │ ──┤ │
    ⇨ │ │   │ │
    ┌─┤ └── │ │
    │ │     │ │
    │ │ ────┘ │
    │         │
    └─────────┘
    ```

2. A rectangular maze 6x18 cells

    ```text
    ┌───────────┬─────────┬───────────┬─┐
    │           │         │           │ │
    │ ┌───────┐ │ ┌─┐ ──┐ └───┐ ┌───┐ │ │
    │ │       │ │ │ │   │     │ │   │   ⇨
    │ └─┐ ┌─┐ │ │ │ ├── ├───┐ │ │ ──┼── │
    │   │ │ │   │   │   │   │ │ │   │   │
    └── │ │ ├───┴───┤ ┌─┘ ┌─┘ │ ├── │ ──┤
    ⇨   │   │       │ │   │   │ │   │   │
    ┌─┬─┴─┐ └─┐ ┌─┐ │ └─┐ │ ┌─┘ │ ──┴─┐ │
    │ │   │   │ │ │ │   │   │   │     │ │
    │ │ │ └── │ │ │ └── │ ──┘ ┌─┘ ──┐ │ │
    │   │       │       │     │     │   │
    └───┴───────┴───────┴─────┴─────┴───┘
    ```

[Box-drawing]: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Box-drawing_character


Do NOT modify the tests or the build files except as stated below. Do not create new files unless the specification requires them; Helper classes may go only in the solution's package."

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Random;

public class MazeGenerator {

    private static final int MIN_SIZE = 5;
    private static final int MAX_SIZE = 100;

    public char[][] generatePerfectMaze(int rows, int columns) {
        return generatePerfectMaze(rows, columns, new Random().nextInt());
    }

    public char[][] generatePerfectMaze(int rows, int columns, int seed) {
        validate(rows, columns);
        Random random = new Random(seed);
        return buildMaze(rows, columns, random);
    }

    private void validate(int rows, int columns) {
        if (rows < MIN_SIZE || rows > MAX_SIZE || columns < MIN_SIZE || columns > MAX_SIZE) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                "rows and columns must be between " + MIN_SIZE + " and " + MAX_SIZE);
        }
    }

    private char[][] buildMaze(int rows, int columns, Random random) {
        // Initialize the grid with all walls present.
        char[][] grid = new char[2 * rows + 1][2 * columns + 1];
        for (int r = 0; r < grid.length; r++) {
            for (int c = 0; c < grid[r].length; c++) {
                if ((r & 1) == 1 && (c & 1) == 1) {
                    grid[r][c] = ' ';      // room
                } else if ((r & 1) == 0 && (c & 1) == 0) {
                    grid[r][c] = '┼';      // intersection (fixed later)
                } else if ((r & 1) == 1 && (c & 1) == 0) {
                    grid[r][c] = '│';      // vertical wall
                } else {
                    grid[r][c] = '─';      // horizontal wall
                }
            }
        }

        // Carve passages with iterative recursive-backtracking (DFS).
        boolean[][] visited = new boolean[rows][columns];
        int[] stackR = new int[rows * columns];
        int[] stackC = new int[rows * columns];
        int top = 0;
        stackR[top] = 0;
        stackC[top] = 0;
        visited[0][0] = true;
        top++;

        int[] dr = {-1, 0, 1, 0};  // up, right, down, left (room coords)
        int[] dc = {0, 1, 0, -1};

        while (top > 0) {
            int r = stackR[top - 1];
            int c = stackC[top - 1];

            // Collect unvisited neighbors.
            List<int[]> options = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int d = 0; d < 4; d++) {
                int nr = r + dr[d];
                int nc = c + dc[d];
                if (nr >= 0 && nr < rows && nc >= 0 && nc < columns && !visited[nr][nc]) {
                    options.add(new int[]{nr, nc, d});
                }
            }

            if (options.isEmpty()) {
                top--;  // backtrack
                continue;
            }

            int[] choice = options.get(random.nextInt(options.size()));
            int nr = choice[0];
            int nc = choice[1];
            int d = choice[2];

            // Remove the wall between (r,c) and (nr,nc).
            grid[2 * r + 1 + dr[d]][2 * c + 1 + dc[d]] = ' ';

            visited[nr][nc] = true;
            stackR[top] = nr;
            stackC[top] = nc;
            top++;
        }

        // Fix up intersection characters.
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * rows; i += 2) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= 2 * columns; j += 2) {
                grid[i][j] = intersectionChar(grid, i, j, rows, columns);
            }
        }

        // Place entrance (left) and exit (right).
        int entranceRow = 1 + 2 * random.nextInt(rows);  // odd char row
        int exitRow = 1 + 2 * random.nextInt(rows);     // odd char row
        grid[entranceRow][0] = '⇨';
        grid[exitRow][2 * columns] = '⇨';

        return grid;
    }

    private char intersectionChar(char[][] grid, int i, int j, int rows, int columns) {
        boolean up = i - 1 >= 0 && isWall(grid[i - 1][j]);
        boolean down = i + 1 <= 2 * rows && isWall(grid[i + 1][j]);
        boolean left = j - 1 >= 0 && isWall(grid[i][j - 1]);
        boolean right = j + 1 <= 2 * columns && isWall(grid[i][j + 1]);

        if (up && down && right) return '├';

        if (down && left) return '┐';
        if (down && right) return '┌';
        if (up || down) return '│';
        if (left || right) return '─';
        return ' ';
    }

    private boolean isWall(char ch) {
        return ch != ' ' && ch != '⇨';
